articles.title: Microwaves Could Make French Fries Way Healthier — And Still Super Crispy!
articles.summary: Imagine fries that are crispy outside, fluffy inside, but soak up way less oil. Scientists used special microwaves to cook fries faster and keep them from getting greasy. They found a clever trick to push oil out, not in. Your fries might get a healthy upgrade!

articles.title: How Did Prehistoric Sharks Get So Gigantic? Five Wild Secrets!
articles.summary: Ancient sharks like the megalodon grew longer than a school bus! Scientists found five reasons they got so huge: they lived where big predators weren't, ate fatty whales, and even had babies that ate each other in the womb. These giant hunters ruled the seas for millions of years.

articles.title: Teens Learn Quantum Teleportation Using Just Pictures!
articles.summary: Can 16-year-olds really understand quantum physics? At a UK summer program, they did — by drawing spider-like diagrams! Instead of scary math, students used pictures to figure out quantum teleportation. One even explained it to the whole class. The secret? The pictures ARE the math.
